description: This file contains unit tests for the ToolResultTextFormatter component, testing its ability to correctly format and summarize JSON data and plain text.

classes.name: ToolResultTextFormatterTests
classes.description: A test suite struct containing multiple test methods for ToolResultTextFormatter.

methods.name: leavesPlainTextUntouched
methods.description: Test ensuring that plain text input remains unchanged after formatting.

methods.name: summarizesNodesListJSON
methods.description: Test verifying that JSON data with node details is summarized correctly, including node count and properties.

methods.name: summarizesErrorJSONAndDropsAgentPrefix
methods.description: Test ensuring an error JSON object is summarized appropriately, dropping agent prefix details.

methods.name: suppressesUnknownStructuredPayload
methods.description: Test that JSON objects not matching expected structure result in an empty output.
